home_description: Share, preview and download custom maimai charts.
error_not_found_body: Nothing lives at this address. It may have been removed or mistyped.
error_server_body: The server ran into a problem with this request. Please try again later.
qq_code_message: [AstroDX Community] Your sign-in code is {code}. It expires in 5 minutes. Only use it to sign in to this site; anyone who asks you for it is a scammer. If you didn't request it, ignore this message.
error_reauth_required: For your security, this needs a sign-in from the last 10 minutes. Please sign in again and retry.
error_last_login_method: You need to keep at least one way to sign in.
error_captcha_failed: The human check didn't pass. Please try again.
error_captcha_unavailable: The human check is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
error_qq_send_rate_limited: Too many codes were requested for this QQ number. Please try again later.
error_qq_code_expired: The code has expired or wasn't requested in this browser. Please request a new one.
error_qq_code_invalid: That code isn't right. Please check it and try again.
error_qq_code_too_many_attempts: Too many wrong attempts. This code no longer works; please request a new one.
error_qq_already_linked: This QQ number is already linked to another account.
error_passkey_not_found: This site has no record of that passkey. It may have been removed.
error_passkey_already_registered: This device already has a passkey for this site.
error_google_already_linked: This Google account is already linked to another account.
error_google_failed: Signing in with Google didn't work. Please try again.
error_current_session: To end this device's session, use "Sign out".
error_rate_limited: Too many requests. Please try again later.
error_unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
login_description: Sign in to AstroDX Community with Google, QQ or a passkey.
login_reauth_notice: For your security, please sign in again, then go back to what you were doing.
login_qq_add_bot: First add the bot {bot} as a friend in QQ. It will send you the code in a private message.
login_qq_console_hint: Local development: the code is printed in the server's terminal.
login_qq_unavailable: QQ sign-in is unavailable right now. Please use a passkey or Google.
login_qq_sent: If this QQ number has added the bot as a friend, the code is on its way.
login_passkey_signup_heading: Sign up with just a passkey
login_passkey_signup_hint: No Google or QQ needed: the passkey stays on your device, and you sign in with your fingerprint, face or device password.
login_turnstile_failed: The human check failed to load. Please refresh the page.
settings_revoke_others: Sign out of all other devices
profile_nickname_hint: 1 to 24 characters. Others may use the same nickname, so your user ID is always shown next to it.
profile_bio_hint: Plain text, up to 300 characters. Line breaks are kept.
onboarding_intro: First, check your nickname. You can write a bio now, or later in your profile.
onboarding_backup_heading: Add a second way to sign in
onboarding_backup_hint: With only one way to sign in, you're locked out if it stops working. We suggest adding a backup.
onboarding_add_passkey: Add a passkey on this device
onboarding_link_accounts: Link QQ or Google in account settings
user_page_pending_body: This account has asked to be deleted and will be removed after a grace period.
account_deletion_scheduled: This account is scheduled to be deleted on {date}.
account_deletion_cancel_hint: Until then you can cancel the deletion and keep using your account.
account_deletion_due: The grace period is over and the account is being deleted. It can no longer be cancelled.
settings_delete_explain: Deleting your account signs you out on every device. An account that hasn't posted anything is deleted right away; otherwise it's kept for 7 days. During that time you can sign in again and cancel the deletion; after that it's deleted.
settings_delete_content_default: What you've posted stays by default, credited to "Deleted user".
settings_delete_confirm: Type your user ID ({id}) to confirm
settings_delete_done: Your account deletion has started, and you've been signed out.
settings_delete_done_scheduled: The account will be deleted on {date}. Sign in before then to cancel.
settings_delete_done_immediate: The account will be deleted within a few minutes.
error_deletion_not_cancellable: The grace period is over, so the deletion can no longer be cancelled.
error_deletion_conflict: Your account deletion is already being processed. Reload the page and try again.
error_bio_too_long: Bios can have at most 300 characters.
